en.name: Cyber Style Successor
en.effect:
You can only use this Skill's second effect once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add 1 "Cyber End Dragon" to your Extra Deck. (You can only have at most 3 copies.)
2: Can be used before your normal draw if your Life Points are at 3000 or below. One of the cards from your normal draw this turn will be a random LIGHT Machine monster from your Deck.
